environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic on port 80 to target group on port 8080. No additional middleware, no authentication proxy. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application handles its own authentication and authorization.

config.alb_rules: default action: forward to target group
